desc:
• IT'S CRUNCH TIME: Zesty snack mix made with breadsticks, pretzels, and rye chips for a satisfyingly crunchy texture
  • INTENSE TASTE: Seasoned with delicious flavors the whole family will enjoy; With unique flavors, it's not your standard snack
  • CRAFTED WITH TRADITION: This crowd-favorite snack mix is based on a signature Gardetto family recipe
  • PARTY FAVORITE: Endless taste and texture combinations make these the perfect party snacks for get-togethers of all shapes and sizes; Not your standard pub mix, trail mix, or bar snack
  • CONTAINS: One 8.6 oz bag of Gardetto's Original Recipe Snack Mix
features:
Features

Crunchy blend of components: A satisfying mix of breadstick ends, salted pretzels, and double-roasted rye chips.

Bold, savory seasoning: Tossed in a zesty blend of garlic, onion, caraway, Worcestershire-style spices, and other seasonings.

Family recipe heritage: Inspired by a 1932 Milwaukee bakery recipe passed down through generations.

Ready-to-eat and shareable: Convenient snack with no preparation required—perfect for parties, road trips, and lunchboxes.

Kosher-certified: Meets kosher dietary standards in select packaging formats.

No cholesterol or trans fat: A flavorful snack made without trans fats or cholesterol. 

 Benefits

Satisfying crunch: Offers a variety of textures in one bag, making every bite interesting and enjoyable.

Unique flavor experience: The signature seasoning delivers a bold, nostalgic taste not found in ordinary snack mixes.

Convenient snacking: Pre-packaged and portable—great for on-the-go munching or casual gatherings.

Homestyle authenticity: Made with a time-tested recipe for that comforting, baked-from-scratch taste.

Guilt-free indulgence: Contains no trans fats or cholesterol, making it a smarter savory snack choice.

Diet-friendly: Kosher and made to accommodate a wide range of snackers.
ingredients: Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, riboflavin, thiamin mononitrate, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (high oleic canola, high oleic soybean, high oleic sunflower, palm, fractionated palm, palm olein and/or soybean), Rye Flour. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Yeast, Sugar, Monosodium Glutamate, Corn Syrup, Maltodextrin, Baking Soda, Dried Worcestershire Sauce (vinegar, molasses, corn syrup, salt, caramel color, garlic powder, sugar, spice, tamarind, natural flavor), Barley Malt Extract, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Fumaric Acid, Caraway, Disodium Inosinate, Disodium Guanylate, Sodium Diacetate, Caramel Color. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
